description: Zastávky a označníky PID is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Regionální organizátor pražské integrované dopravy (ROPID). List of all stations, stops and PIDs including all available data: location, name, identifier, tariff zone, habitat number, municipality, district, passing lines and their directions. Coverage: Regionální organizátor pražské integrované dopravy (ROPID). The portal shows the English title as "PID stops and flags" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Regionální organizátor pražské integrované dopravy (ROPID). Its keywords include pid, označníky, zastávky. The listing shows 3 download or service links in XML, JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/60437359/b1cfab140bb42c068906fd5364113110/distribuce/d8243eaaacc6be75e3d88522aaec805b/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
